page.overview:
Who is Alpha-001?

Alpha-001 is a character in the Real American Hero comics continuity.

Alpha-001 is artificial intelligence created by Revanche Robotics.

Alpha-001 started in the IDW RAH comics and continued in the Skybound RAH comics.

Alpha-001 is the leader of the Revanche faction as well as the Blue Ninja.
